description: Minimum for the main window: receive events, native save/open dialogs (open also picks the data folder), following the app theme in the title bar, zooming the app's own page (Settings > Interface size), showing the data folder in the file manager (reveal only: it opens nothing), and opening https links (repo pages, websites) in the system browser. The sidecar commands (sidecar_info, restart_sidecar) and the update commands (app_version, check_for_update, install_update) are app commands and need no grant; the updater plugin's own JS commands are deliberately not granted.
